description: This file defines the LateralColumnAliasResolver class, which handles resolution of lateral column references in Spark SQL's logical plan analysis, specifically within Project and Aggregate operators. It includes methods for replacing aggregates with projects, building multi-level projects to resolve lateral dependencies, and updating alias trees.

classes.name: LateralColumnAliasResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving lateral column references in Spark SQL's logical plan, particularly within Project and Aggregate operators. It provides methods to handle lateral column aliasing, replace aggregates with projects, and build multi-level projects to resolve dependencies.

methods.name: handleLcaInAggregate
methods.description: Processes an Aggregate node with lateral column references by replacing it with a Project(Aggregate) structure, validating the new aggregate, and resolving lateral column aliases within the Project.

methods.name: buildProjectWithResolvedLca
methods.description: Constructs a multi-level Project plan with all lateral column aliases and their dependencies, based on alias dependency levels and scope.

methods.name: extractLcaAndReplaceAggWithProject
methods.description: Replaces an Aggregate with lateral column references with a Project that extracts aggregate and grouping expressions, creating aliases for them.

methods.name: extractAggregateAndGroupingExpressions
methods.description: Recursively extracts aggregate and grouping expressions from an Aggregate node that contains lateral column references.

methods.name: getOrUpdateMapping
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an Alias for a given expression, ensuring each expression has a unique alias.

methods.name: updateAliasTrees
methods.description: Updates alias expression trees based on remapped aliases to maintain correct references after resolution.
